name: Damian Velasquez | Modern Metal Fabrication
old_description: Damian Velasquez produced multiple award winning Furniture lines during his career. From silversmithing jewelry with his father to exhibiting his modern, Italian inspired steel and wood furniture at national trade shows, Damian achieved a respectable career as a designer, craftsman, and artist.
type_evidence: This site serves to commemorate his now retired furniture and design portfolio.
